purpose: Formal domain specification, business logic, and architectural boundaries for the cynic-release micro-crate.

ownership.primary: Pure decision engine for release validation, semver qualification, and public relay projection eligibility.
owns: Parsing and evaluation of machine-readable release contracts (release-gates, relay-policy, release-versioning, staging-model)
Pure domain types: ReleaseVersion, ReleaseCandidate, GateProofRecord, GateEvaluationReport, ReleaseEligibilityVerdict, RelayDecisionProof
Pure evaluation rules: gate compliance scoring, semver monotonicity, conventional commit classification, tag integrity

delegates.responsibility: Build and artifact execution gates (cargo check, cargo test, make build-release)
Git transport, push, tag ref creation, worktree inspection, and remote ls-remote read-backs
Low-layer host OS primitives, clock, and secret material resolution
Operator command-line parsing, argument validation, and output rendering

forbidden: Direct process spawning via std::process::Command (Zero-I/O domain core)
Direct network HTTP/TCP communication (e.g. reqwest, hyper)
Direct filesystem mutation inside decision logic (std::fs::write, std::fs::remove_file)
Upward dependencies: MUST NEVER depend on cynic-host, cynic-kernel, cynic-node, cynic-cli, or cynic-mcp

inputs: GateProofRecords (evidence of cargo_check, unit_tests, secret_lint, architecture_boundary)
RelayTopology (sovereign remote identity, relay remote identity, current observed refs)
evaluation_steps: 1. Verify proposed release version matches SemVer format and strict monotonic ordering against prior tags
2. Check mandatory gates against supplied GateProofRecords; require 100% pass and 0 secret findings
3. Classify conventional commits to verify tag bump magnitude (major, minor, patch)
4. If all gates satisfied, produce ReleaseEligibilityVerdict::Eligible with signed proof hash
5. Evaluate relay policy: if sovereign branch is ahead, produce RelayDecisionProof::Authorized with exact target ref and method
outputs: RelayDecisionProof (Authorized { target_remote, target_ref, method } | Rejected { blockers })

invariants: Strict DAG downward: cynic-release depends ONLY on cynic-protocol (and standard serialization/error crates)
Every decision produces an immutable, machine-readable verdict with a schema identifier and timestamp
Automated architectural tests in tests/architecture_boundary.rs verify no forbidden imports or I/O calls
